messages:
emma: opening a PR to harmonize header names and clarify pricing panel behavior. main changes: canonicalize to `X-Cost-Tier` across pricing/quota docs, add a tiny SDKv5 fetch example, and tweak the Grafana panel to show cost-per-minute instead of cost-per-hour. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6120

raj: SG. can you include a short migration note for customers who forked panels? they need the exact panel UID and the query diff.

emma: will do. panel UID is G-costpm9. query change: replace `sum(billing.cost_hour)` with `sum by (tier) (rate(billing.cost_seconds[1m])) * 60`. added a 1-line explanation about why per-minute is more stable for bursty workloads.

claire: please also include an explicit SDKv5 fetch snippet that shows header usage and Authorization so folks copy-paste safely. many people missed the header in the recorded fixtures.

emma: added snippet: 
```
// fetch (SDKv5 style)
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-Cost-Tier': 'enterprise'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'open-7b', input: 'Summarize billing behavior' })
});
```

tom: small nit: add a 429 example for pricing docs showing `retry_after` semantics and `scope: tier` vs `scope: account`. customers ask which scope they hit.

emma: added 429 example body: `{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "scope": "tier", "retry_after": 45 }` and a sentence: "scope=tier => request header/route tier exceeded; scope=account => global account allowance exhausted."

claire: also add a cross-ref note that older docs used `X-Usage-Tier` and `X-Quota-Tier`; mention both are accepted by the API for backward compat but recommend `X-Cost-Tier` going forward.

emma: done. added migration snippet for customers who search the docs: `If you used X-Usage-Tier or X-Quota-Tier, replace with X-Cost-Tier in new examples; API accepts old headers but new docs standardize on X-Cost-Tier.`

docs-bot: running lint + snippet-tests + linkcheck on PR #6120.

docs-bot: snippet-tests failed: recorded fixture expected header `X-Usage-Tier` in HTTP mock. please update test fixtures or record new ones.

emma: thanks. updated fixtures to assert `X-Cost-Tier` and re-recorded the failing snippet. also updated the test harness note.

docs-bot: all checks green after fixture update. linkcheck auto-fixed one moved anchor in /billing/overview. CI green at 4801230075.

raj: nice. i'll add a follow-up task to the migration checklist to ping partners about the header canonicalization.

emma: will post a short announcement to #customer-docs after the site rebuild. closing out here.
